definition: the belief under the scar, what replaced it, and what the replacement has me do

settled:
The old belief, in my compression: I cannot afford to be creative, it is just too expensive. Making priced itself out and the whole open register got cut.

Two beliefs replace it. First, most open making sets off a conditioned post-traumatic reflex, not a thought that someone will judge me. Second, these are things impossible to get consistently right, which authority figures criticised me for where my survival was at stake, and the two together charged it.

The installers, deepest first: the deprivation floor, the same hands punishing a child nobody could read, the suspension at five, art class at about twelve, one mild criticism of my singing from Jen.

A reflex lifts by exposure, not argument. So the new behaviour is metered doses of the charged act from safety four up; below that the feelings are not available and exposure reinforces instead.

The sharing rule is a valve, not a wall. Making alone rides the act test; sharing rides the result test until the fusion resolves.

title: The Dig I Ran On Making
